alt: Real ChatGPT /questionbank execution: fast prompt entry, sending, accelerated generation and normal-speed widget use.
caption: New temporary chat → PDF → shortcut → generation → extended widget use
prompt: /questionbank Using only the attached chapter, create an interactive bank of three questions on training, inference and context. Include answer fields, reveal/hide explanations and progress. Answer in English.
setupPrompt: Use the attached chapter as the only source for the next activity. Please wait for my next request.

phases.name: upload
phases.caption: Open a new temporary chat and upload the chapter PDF.

phases.name: setup-generation
phases.caption: ChatGPT reads the uploaded chapter · accelerated.

phases.name: typing
phases.caption: Write the shortcut request as the second message.

phases.name: send
phases.caption: Send the shortcut as the second message.

phases.name: widget
phases.caption: Inspect the generated widget before using its controls.

phases.name: usage
phases.caption: Use the widget at normal speed.

actions.label: Write an independent answer about parameter changes.
Reveal the first explanation for comparison.
Mark the first question Reviewed after comparing the reasoning.
Answer the prompt-context question in your own words.
Reveal the second explanation and compare the distinction.
Write why retrieval supplies context but still requires verification.
Reveal the retrieval explanation and compare it with the written answer.
Inspect the completed three-question progress indicator.
Reset the activity for another independent practice session.

deliveryNormalization.method: Aspect-preserving Lanczos downsample from 1664x1040 to 1440x900. H.264 CRF14; original 60 fps cadence and duration preserved. Native media retained in the ignored pre-pull review archive.
